description: Natural gas utilities and gas marketers
coverage_notes:
[gas-central] Roster basis: HIFLD 'Natural Gas Local Distribution Company Service Territories' layer (1,294 records nationally, EIA-176/AGA-derived, source date ~2017) filtered to LDC_STATE in the 19 scope states = 847 territory rows. Every in-scope row is represented: rows belonging to a researched company are folded into that company's detailed entry (see build exclusion list), all others are kept as roster entries (720) with HIFLD residential customer count, HQ city and website (website liveness checked 2026-09-29; dead sites set to null with a note). Detailed tier (90 entries) covers every investor-owned LDC in scope with a meaningful residential base (Nicor, Peoples, North Shore, Ameren IL/MO, Consumers, DTE, SEMCO, MGU, Citizens Gas Fuel, We Energies, WPS, MGE, Alliant, Xcel/NSP, CenterPoint MN/IN/OH, MERC, Great Plains, Greater MN Gas, MidAmerican, Black Hills, Liberty, Spire incl. Spire Tennessee (ex-Piedmont TN, sale closed 2026-03-31), Atmos, Delta Utilities (ex-CenterPoint LA/MS and Entergy gas), Summit Utilities AR/OK, AOG, Summit NG of Missouri, ONG, Kansas Gas Service, Midwest Energy, MDU, NorthWestern, Columbia Gas OH/KY, NIPSCO, Enbridge Gas Ohio, Duke OH/KY, LG&E, Delta Natural Gas, Chattanooga Gas, Ohio Valley Gas, Midwest NG (IN/WI), Indiana Natural Gas, Ohio Gas, Suburban NG, NEO, St. Croix Valley NG) and every municipal/public gas system HIFLD reports with >=10,000 residential customers that has a working website (MLGW, Citizens Energy Group, M.U.D. Omaha, KUB, City Utilities Springfield, MTNG, Huntsville, Duluth Comfort Systems, JEA, Clarksville G&W, Hamilton OH, Alexandria LA, NAGD, Decatur, Florence, GDGA, Terrebonne/Houma, Elk River PUD, Cedar Falls, Oak Ridge UD, NWAGD, Cullman-Jefferson, Gibson County UD, Moss Point, Olive Branch) plus several 8–10k systems (Sevier County UD, Citizens Gas UD, Owatonna, Austin, Watertown, PIE&G). Cross-checked against: Wikipedia 'List of United States natural gas companies' (all in-scope retail LDCs named there are present), utility gas-choice supplier lists (Columbia Gas of Ohio, Columbia Gas of Kentucky, NIPSCO), and ownership changes found on official sites this session (Spire acquisition of Piedmont TN; Delta Utilities; Summit acquisition of CenterPoint AR/OK; Enbridge acquisition of Dominion East Ohio; CenterPoint rebrand of Vectren). Link verification: all detailed-entry URLs were fetched this session (curl/WebFetch or rendered in a browser for JS sites such as Xcel, Duke, SEMCO, Liberty, Spire); a final bulk re-check returned 200 for ~470 of 531 URLs, 403 for login portals, and connection timeouts for ~30 URLs on sites that had loaded earlier in the session (network flakiness, not dead links). HIFLD customer counts are residential and ~2016 vintage; some are imputed (e.g., identical 2,938/8,336 values) and parent/owner names are stale — roster entries should be re-verified before use. REVIEWER PASS 2026-09-29: (1) Link health: re-checked all 460 distinct URLs on detailed entries with curl — 455 returned 200, 4 were 403 bot-blocks on Utility Nexus login portals (MTNG, ORUD, SCUD), and one Midwest Natural Gas PDF URL containing raw spaces was fixed by percent-encoding it. Page titles were scanned for soft-404s and none were found. (2) Content re-fetched and gaps filled for Atmos (statements_history), SEMCO (autopay_cancel), M.U.D. (paperless, mail, phone line, Paymentus), Midwest Energy (autopay form, pay-by-phone, history), Delta Natural Gas (e-Account, Speedpay phone and fees), Huntsville Utilities (pay-by-phone, assistance referral), Peoples Gas (extra WEC pages), and CenterPoint MN/IN/OH (phones confirmed on the Contact Us page; no public pay-by-phone number). (3) Six roster entries were upgraded to detailed after their official sites were fetched: Marshall County Gas District AL, Superior Water Light & Power WI, West Texas Gas (OK panhandle), Northeast Oklahoma Public Facilities Authority, Lancaster Municipal Gas OH, and Hastings Utilities NE. (4) The 36-name Nicor Gas Customer Select residential supplier list (IL) was added: 16 new roster entries, and 20 existing suppliers had IL added to their service area. Remaining gaps: roster systems with 10,000+ HIFLD customers still lacking working official sites are Southeast Alabama Gas District (seagd.net dead), Trussville Gas & Water, South Coast Gas (LA) and National Gas & Oil / The Energy Cooperative (Cloudflare-blocked). Michigan (MPSC) and Peoples Gas Choices For You supplier lists were not fetched (MPSC returned 403). Web search was unavailable to the reviewer (session search budget exhausted), so discovery relied on direct fetches. BACKFILL PASS 2026-09-30 (change set: categories/roster-backfill-gas-central.json): (1) Municipal/public gas rows with no website: 399 -> 192 still missing (all no-website rows 483 -> 232). Sites were found by cross-referencing the same town's utility in other category files (water/electric), checking likely official domains (city/town/village and utility-name patterns, tens of thousands of candidate domains resolved by DNS, then fetched), the Alabama Natural Gas Association locator, the KY Gas Association directory, and web search (search budget ran out after ~70 municipal lookups; a Kentucky directory crawl was rate-limited and stopped). Every accepted site was fetched and title/city matched; 159 roster rows now carry a pay_bill link that is visible on the official site. Remaining municipal rows without a site by state: LA 31, IL 28, OK 25, KY 19, KS 16, MS 16, MO 15, TN 11, IA 8, IN 6, AL 5, AR 4, OH 4, MN 2, SD 1, WI 1. Most are very small towns (often <500 gas customers) that publish no website; call the HIFLD phone on the entry. (2) Upgraded to detailed: The Energy Cooperative (ex-National Gas & Oil), Southeast Gas (Southeast Alabama Gas District), Trussville Gas and Water, Knox Energy Cooperative (Utility Pipeline Ltd / EvokePay), South Coast Gas and West Tennessee PUD, plus AEP Energy, Ohio Natural Gas and Major Energy among Ohio gas-choice marketers. (3) Detailed-tier link coverage now: autopay_cancel 63/105, statements_history 72/105, view_bill 72/105, autopay_setup 82/105, pay_bill 101/105 (only filled where a fetched official page says it; many small utilities only handle bank-draft cancellation by phone/office). (4) Ohio gas-choice supplier websites/phones filled from the PUCO Apples-to-Apples charts; suppliers still without a site: Boardwalk Continuum Marketing, LLC, Discount Power Inc., Energy Plus Natural Gas, LLC, MPower Energy NJ, LLC, New Wave Energy LLC, Novec Energy Solutions Inc., StateWise Energy Ohio LLC, Verde Energy USA Ohio, LLC. Georgia marketers are covered in gas-east.json. Known corrections: Orwell Natural Gas and Brainard Gas now bill as Northeast Ohio Natural Gas; United Cities Gas is Atmos Energy; HIFLD's Ohio Valley Gas Sullivan row duplicates the detailed OVG entry; Verona Natural Gas appears to be billed by Glenwood Energy (unconfirmed). REVIEWER PASS 2026-09-30 (second pass on the backfill): (1) Websites. The backfill's site-guessing had accepted pages that were not real sites. perry-mo.gov is a parked GoDaddy domain, so Perry's website was removed. Four recorded titles were Cloudflare challenge pages ('Just a moment...'): Monroe City MO, Manning IA, Attica KS and Carrollton KY were re-confirmed in a browser and given pay links where shown. All 547 roster websites were re-fetched to find parked or dead domains. Fixed: White Castle LA and Scribner NE (both had HugeDomains sale pages), Two Harbors MN (dead host), Humboldt SD (404), Dunlap TN (cPanel default page), Oberlin LA, Selmer TN (parked) and GUD East Baton Rouge (gud1.net works without www). Removed: Cassoday KS (parked), American Midstream (domain for sale) and Windy City Energy (suspended). Then, with Bing run in a browser (the WebSearch budget was exhausted), every remaining no-website row was searched by town and by HIFLD phone. 70 more gas-utility rows got an official site and/or pay page (68 sites, plus 2 with only a PayStation pay page); each was accepted only when the fetched page showed the HIFLD phone or the town and its gas service. No-website rows went from 232 to 160 (municipal/public from 195 to 133 by entity_type; the backfill reported 192 using a slightly different count). Roster rows with a pay_bill link went from 159 to 220. (2) Mergers and removals. Aurora Gas Company (MI) was bought by PIE&G in 2018 and Creal Springs IL has been served by Liberty Utilities since 2019; both rows were removed and noted on the surviving entries. The Arlington, Barlow, Kevil, LaCenter and Wickliffe KY rows share New Commonwealth Natural Gas's phone and were pointed at its site; this is inferred, because the site does not name the towns. Humboldt SD's 8,336 customers was an imputed HIFLD value and was set to null. Virginia Public Utilities (MN) is flagged as an HIFLD mislabel of Westbrook. Alabaster Water & Gas Board's site mentions only water. Elizabeth Natural Gas's phone matches D&H Gas Co. (3) Link accuracy. All 544 URLs on the 280 backfill entries were re-fetched (504 returned 200; the 403s were Utility Nexus, Nexbillpay and Paymentus portals or Cloudflare sites). The autopay_cancel and statements_history pages on 29 detailed entries were read for content. CenterPoint, Alliant, Liberty, Trussville, Elk River, MTNG, South Coast and Delta Gas say what they are used for. The autopay_cancel links for Liberty, Alliant, The Energy Cooperative, West Tennessee PUD, Southeast Gas and Constellation only describe enrollment. They were kept under the schema's same-page convention, with notes saying how to cancel. Added PayUB pay-by-phone numbers for PCUD, GCUD and NWAGD, and payment processors for Alexandria LA, GDGA, CJ Gas, Cedar Falls (Paymentus) and Ohio Gas (Nexbillpay). Energy Harbor's billing FAQ was linked and its residential phone, 1-877-855-2424, added. IGS's My Account login URL was corrected. (4) Marketers. All 8 Ohio and Kentucky suppliers that had no website now have one (Boardwalk Continuum, the former Spire Marketing; Discount Power; Energy Plus; MPower; StateWise; Verde; Novec Energy Solutions), except New Wave Energy, which NextEra bought and which was given a note instead. Using the MPSC DTE supplier list, 7 missing Michigan Gas Choice suppliers were added (Ardent, Bishop, Dillon, MIG&E, Michigan Natural Gas, Grand Rapids Energy/SouthStar, Tomorrow Energy) and 17 existing suppliers got MI coverage. Detailed-tier link coverage is unchanged by this pass: autopay_cancel 63/105, statements_history 72/105. THIRD PASS 2026-10-01 (continuation; WebSearch budget was exhausted after a few queries, so discovery used direct fetches, utility sitemaps and WebFetch). (1) Detailed-tier link coverage raised: autopay_cancel 63 -> 72 of 106 and statements_history 72 -> 82 of 106 (view_bill 72 -> 82, autopay_setup 82 -> 88). New history links: WEC family (We Energies, WPS, MERC, MGU, Peoples Gas, North Shore Gas) My Account/app FAQ (bill history by date range, 24 months of payment history), AOG and Summit NG of Missouri 'What's New' (portal has downloadable statements and transaction history), Austin Utilities (SmartHub), CJ Gas (online payment history). New cancel links: Atmos (Automatic Payment Plan Agreement: cancel in Account Center or at 888-286-6700, effective next cycle), Citizens Gas Fuel (portal manual 'Remove Auto Pay'), Ohio Valley Gas (district Direct Debit forms with a Cancel box, 3 business days' notice), Indiana Natural Gas (Direct Pay authorization: written termination), Owatonna (cancel in SmartHub), NEO (new Nov-2025 My Account AutoPay), Huntsville and M.U.D. (enrollment pages; notes say how to cancel). Pay-by-phone numbers added for OVG (1-833-874-7385), NEO (Paymentus 833-425-1817), ORUD ((865) 220-6600), SWL&P (Speedpay 1-866-678-8868), Citizens Gas Fuel (888-598-9846). NEO's pay link was moved from a new-service page to its Ways to Pay page. GDGA's bank-draft paragraph is hidden on the live page, so no autopay link was added. (2) Marketers: Spark Energy Gas upgraded to detailed (consolidated utility billing outside Texas; AutoPay/PayStar page explicitly covers cancel). IGS got a view_bill link to its official explainer that supplier charges appear on the utility bill and are paid to the utility. Energy Harbor's FAQ answers load by script and could not be read, so it stays roster; Gas South's site is Georgia-focused and Ohio CHOICE customers are billed by Columbia Gas, so it was not upgraded. (3) No-website rows: still 160. A domain probe for the larger systems (Pontotoc MS 6,700, Chelsea OK, Nashville IL, Bushnell IL, Lake County UD TN, Evangeline Natural Gas, Fort Cobb, DeQuincy, Westbrook MN, Unionville MO, Jonesville LA and others) found only parked pages or city sites that do not mention gas service or the HIFLD phone, so none were accepted. Still missing: autopay_cancel on 34 detailed entries and statements_history on 24, mostly small municipal and district systems whose sites only say to call or visit the office (Clarksville G&W, GCUD, NWAGD, Florence, Moss Point, Olive Branch, Terrebonne, Lancaster OH and Hastings among them), plus MidAmerican, whose support pages do not describe bill history. REVIEW5 (2026-10-02, skeptical reviewer pass): every link on every detailed entry (337 unique URLs) was re-requested with curl; all returned HTTP 200 except six portal pages behind bot walls (Paymentus ubct, three Utility Nexus portals, NexBillPay MCGD), which are kept. The pay pages of 42 detailed entries were re-read and their listed phone numbers matched the page text, except CenterPoint, Southeast Gas and ORUD (JavaScript or Cloudflare pages; Southeast Gas then checked with WebFetch and it matched). Corrections: Decatur Utilities' pay-by-phone is 1-844-965-1351 (the 256-552-1400 opt. 3 line covers after-hours reconnection payments), and its sample bill PDF is now view_bill; Spark help_center now /faqs. New links: PCUD autopay_cancel (PayUB portal), ERPUD view_bill, and assistance and senior programs for GDGA, SCUD (Neighbors Helping Neighbors) and Alexandria (Council on Aging energy assistance). 17 roster systems were upgraded to detailed after their pages were fetched: Fremont NE (Paymentus, CareShare), Cookeville, Fultondale, Humphreys County UD, Dyersburg, Lebanon TN (it has a separate cancel-bank-draft form), Springfield TN, Henderson KY (VPS), Paris-Henry County PUD, Sycamore Gas (new My Account system since Nov 2025), Denham Springs LA (senior fee discount on sewer and garbage), Ripley TN, Hardeman-Fayette UD, Richmond KY, GUD #1 East Baton Rouge, Savannah TN (thin) and Virginia Public Utilities MN. The Virginia MN row was fixed: HIFLD had given it Westbrook's location and phone, and its site was found at vpuc.com. Websites found through web search and confirmed by fetch for rows that had none: Bushnell IL (the utilities phone matches HIFLD), Pikeville KY (Edmunds WIPP payments) and Fort Cobb Fuel Authority (run by Navitas Utility Corp.). Pontotoc MS and Harrisburg AR have likely official sites (pontotocms.org/gas/, hbgwatergas.com), but both failed to load, so they stay null and are recorded only in notes. Gallatin TN's gallatinutilities.com returned 403, so it was not upgraded. All changes were applied in place to categories/gas-central.json, and the changed rows were added to this change-set file.

[gas-east] Checked against HIFLD LDC roster (255 LDC rows in the 18 in-scope states/DC): every HIFLD operator in scope is represented (PPL Gas Utilities is now part of UGI Utilities; Connecticut Natural Gas and Tri-County present under normalized names). All investor-owned LDCs are detailed-tier, including Avangrid companies (NYSEG, RG&E, SCG, CNG, Berkshire) whose live sites block bots - their links were cross-checked via 2025-26 Wayback snapshots and left verified=false. Georgia: all 10 residential certified marketers on the GA PSC list (Constellation, Fuel Georgia, Gas South, Georgia Natural Gas, SCANA Energy, Stream, Town Square, True Natural Gas, Walton EMC Natural Gas, XOOM) are included; Atlanta Gas Light included as distributor-only. Municipal/public gas systems with >10k customers are detailed (incl. York County NGA, Lawrenceville, Buford, Sugar Hill, Albany GA, Danville VA, Richmond, GUC, Fort Hill, Austell, Okaloosa, GRU, Tallahassee, Pensacola, etc.) except Clinton-Newberry NGA (SC, ~12.8k) whose website refused connections. Smaller municipal and private systems are roster-tier from HIFLD (2017 data; customer counts are 2017 and some names/ownership have changed, e.g. Equitable Gas -> Peoples, Dominion Energy WV -> Hope Gas, Bangor Natural Gas -> Unitil). Choice/ESCO suppliers in NY, NJ, PA, MD, DC, VA, MA, CT etc. are NOT listed individually: in those states residential supplier charges are normally consolidated on the utility bill; only Georgia (full unbundling) requires separate marketer billers. Gaps: PHMSA/EIA-176 current operator lists not cross-checked (PHMSA download blocked); roster-tier entries lack support links and many roster websites are HIFLD values not re-fetched (verified=false); small post-2017 systems may be missing. REVIEW PASS 2026-09-29 (skeptical second pass): (1) Completeness re-checked by fuzzy-matching all 245 in-scope HIFLD LDC rows against entry names/notes - all covered (misspelled 'Conneticut Natural Gas' and three Chesapeake DE rows map to existing entries). PHMSA annual-report download still returns 403. (2) Removed the 'Equitable Gas Co. (Peoples Natural Gas)' WV roster row - Peoples Gas WV (ex-Equitable) was acquired by Hope Gas on 2023-10-02 (noted in Hope Gas entry); merged duplicate HIFLD rows for Valley Energy (PA/NY) and Bluefield Gas (WV/VA); corrected Pike County Light & Power website from coned.com to pclpeg.com. (3) HTTP-checked every detailed-tier URL (474) - non-200s were bot walls (Avangrid, Greenwood CPW, Albany GA, CGS Energy, Chesapeake, Wilson NC, Paymentus portals, Easton, Fuel Georgia), not dead links; one renamed page (Lawrenceville assistance) fixed. (4) Re-read ~32 detailed entries live: the five Avangrid companies (NYSEG, RG&E, SCG, CNG, Berkshire) were read in a rendering browser and upgraded to verified=true with confirmed pay-by-phone numbers and mail addresses; Central Hudson set to verified=false (live site shows a security-check wall; contact center 845-452-2700 taken from a 2025 Wayback capture). Filled previously null links for Washington Gas, Peoples, Piedmont, Enbridge NC, FCG, VGS, Hope Gas, Mountaineer, Rhode Island Energy, Dominion Energy SC, PECO, BGE, Delmarva, National Fuel, Walton, True Natural Gas, Rocky Mount, GRU; added processors (Paymentus for Hope Gas, Invoice Cloud for WG+E, Kubra EZ-PAY cash for Washington Gas, PayNearMe for VGS). Remaining null autopay_cancel/statements_history values generally mean the utility documents these only inside the logged-in portal. WebSearch budget was exhausted this pass, so discovery relied on direct fetches, sitemaps and Wayback CDX. BACKFILL PASS 2026-09-30 (change set: categories/roster-backfill-gas-east-west.json): (1) Rows with no website went from 55 to 21. Georgia municipal gas systems were matched to city sites (Cartersville, Waynesboro, Elberton, Sparta, Thomson-McDuffie, Lumpkin, Nashville, Camilla, Dublin, Moultrie, Vienna, Americus, Fitzgerald, Pelham, Ocilla, Adairsville, Grantville, Doerun, Bowman, Trion, Cuthbert, Calhoun, Fort Gaines, Royston, Union Point (Tri-County Natural Gas), Monroe, Andersonville, Hartwell, Greensboro, Monticello). Live Oak and Havana FL, Bath NY and Union Oil & Gas WV were also matched, and each gained a pay_bill link. A pay_bill link was also added to 40 roster rows that already had a website. Hijacked or parked HIFLD domains were removed or replaced: Jasper FL (now a casino page), Fort Meade FL (lottery page, replaced with cityoffortmeade.org), Milton FL, Marianna FL (wrong city), Chattahoochee FL and Claxton GA. (2) Upgraded to detailed: Cartersville, Laurens CPW, Chester County NGA, Dalton Utilities (dutil.com), Orangeburg DPU, Covington, Fountain Inn, Toccoa, Winder, Warner Robins, Sunrise FL, LaGrange and Union SC. Some of these are partial because the sites publish little. Clinton-Newberry NGA (cnnga.com) still refuses connections and is the only 5,000+ GA/SC/AL/FL municipal system left at roster tier. (3) Detailed-tier coverage is now autopay_cancel 75/97 (was 60) and statements_history 73/97 (was 70). Still missing: small Pennsylvania private gas companies (Riemer, Andreassi, S.A.R., Dunmire, Chartiers, Swissvale, Sergeant, Larkin, Kaib & Kaib, North East Heat & Light, Honesdale), WV (Consumers Gas Utility, Standard Gas, Lumberport-Shinnston), and GA (Louisville, where louisvillega.gov is parked; Dawson, Colquitt, Edison, Shellman). Cartersville went all-paperless on 1/1/2026, which matters for seniors without email. || 2026-09-30 pass 2 (change set: categories/roster-backfill-gas-east-west.json): (1) Rows with no website went from 21 to 16 (55 at the start of this round): Louisville GA (Xpress Bill Pay), Colquitt GA (billingdoc.net, ACH form), Shellman GA (SecureUtilities), Jasper FL (jasperfl.gov) and North East Heat & Light PA (being taken over by National Fuel). (2) Upgraded to detailed: Fort Pierce Utilities Authority, Gulf Breeze, Wakefield MGLD, Shelby NC, Lexington NC and Chambersburg PA. Still missing: small Pennsylvania private gas companies (Riemer, Herman Reimer, Andreassi, S.A.R., Dunmire, Chartiers, Swissvale, Sergeant, Larkin, Kaib & Kaib, Honesdale), WV (Consumers Gas Utility, which reportedly moved to Hope Gas, though no fetched page confirmed it; Standard Gas; Lumberport-Shinnston), and Georgia Edison. Exelon (BGE, PECO, Delmarva) and Avangrid (SCG, CNG, Berkshire) history pages need a login or a script and could not be confirmed. || REVIEW 2026-10-02 (reviewer, change set categories/roster-backfill-gas-east-west.json): Ran an HTTP check on all detailed-entry links; none returned 404. Clinton-Newberry Natural Gas Authority (SC, about 12.8k customers) was upgraded to detailed. It moved to the state-hosted site cnnga.sc.gov; the old cnnga.com only shows a SonicWall login. [gas-west] Roster basis: HIFLD 'Natural Gas Local Distribution Company Service Territories' layer (1,294 LDC territories nationally, attributes derived from EIA-176, EIA shapefile and AGA data, dated ~2015-2017), filtered to LDC_STATE in the 14 in-scope states (193 territory records). Every in-scope record is represented: 36 detailed entries cover all investor-owned LDCs and every municipal/co-op/private system with >10k customers (several detailed entries merge multi-state records, e.g., Atmos TX+CO, Southwest Gas AZ+NV+CA, Avista WA+ID+OR, Black Hills CO+WY, Enbridge UT+WY+ID), and the remaining 145 smaller systems are roster entries; roster websites were test-fetched (verified=true only where the page loaded and matched; 8 wrong/parked HIFLD websites removed). Added 5 systems missing from HIFLD: Interior Alaska Natural Gas Utility (successor to Fairbanks Natural Gas), Alpine Natural Gas (CA), UNIGAS (renamed Universal Natural Gas), City of Coalinga (CA, unconfirmed), and SCE's Catalina Island piped-propane system. Ownership changes captured: Questar/Dominion Energy Utah-Wyoming-Idaho is now Enbridge Gas; Energy West Montana and Cut Bank Gas became NorthWestern Energy on July 1, 2025 (alias entry); West Texas Gas is now WTG Energy; Grey Forest Utilities site moved. Cross-checked against Wikipedia 'List of United States natural gas companies' (sparse; no additional in-scope LDCs) and company service-area knowledge. Customer counts for detailed entries are approximate (company-reported or HIFLD); roster counts are HIFLD 2015-2017 totals. Known gaps: NV Energy (northern Nevada gas) pages are JavaScript-rendered, so its phone/mail/processor are null and entry is verified=false; CenterPoint Texas gas mailing address and pay-by-phone number not found on fetched pages; UNS Gas mailing address not found; several detailed entries lack a public autopay-cancel or statement-history help page because those are handled inside the logged-in portal. Texas has many tiny municipal and private gas systems (Railroad Commission-regulated) that may not all appear in HIFLD; a TX RRC gas utility list and EIA-176 respondent query (https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/ngqs/) should be used on the next pass. Propane-only small-town systems are out of scope (see propane category). REVIEW PASS (2026-09-29): all 226 unique URLs on the 36 detailed entries were status-checked with curl. City sites for Mesa, Palo Alto, Long Beach and Las Cruces return 403 to curl, so Mesa and Palo Alto were re-read through WebFetch. Phone numbers were cross-checked against the fetched pages, and content checks were done on about 20 entries. Fixes made: (1) Hughes Natural Gas became EPCOR Gas Texas, and since June 3, 2025 it is Pines Gas (a SiEnergy subsidiary). The entry was renamed and filled with Pines Gas pay, phone and mail details. (2) NorthWestern Energy's Montana customer service number was corrected to 888-467-2669 in both NWE entries. The old 800-245-6977 is the SD/NE line. (3) The two NTUA records (AZ and UT) were merged into one entry. It now has the portal, payment page, phone, and the 10% senior discount (age 60+, income $21k or less). (4) City of Coalinga's gas utility was confirmed and filled in (Invoice Cloud, IVR 833-857-0953). (5) Links were filled in: Southwest Gas view_bill; SiEnergy view_bill and mailing address; UNS Gas mailing address and ez-pay guest-pay portal; Cascade paperless; Hawaii Gas autopay_cancel (FAQ) and paperless; Palo Alto view_bill, paperless, history, autopay_cancel and mailing address; NV Energy northern Nevada phone numbers (found in the site's JS). (6) CPS Energy view_bill was set to null, because its 'Understand My Bill' link now redirects to a fuel-charges page. (7) Nine roster websites that no longer resolve in DNS, plus one parked domain, were set to null. The Vernon, Los Alamos and Waller websites were updated to their redirect targets. Completeness: the only in-scope change found was the Pines Gas succession. Web search was unavailable in this review pass (search budget exhausted), so no new search-based discovery was done beyond fetching official sites. A Texas RRC gas-utility list is still the recommended next check. BACKFILL PASS 2026-09-30 (change set: categories/roster-backfill-gas-east-west.json): (1) Rows with no website went from 81 to 50. Official city, authority and company sites were found by matching the same town in other category files, by checking likely city domains through DNS and then fetching each one, and by opening bot-blocked sites in a browser. Every accepted site was fetched and its title and town checked. New sites include Robstown Utility Systems, Uvalde, Boerne, Hempstead, Denver City, Big Lake, Lordsburg, Mountainair, Eunice, Raton Natural Gas, Pinedale Natural Gas (operator of Walden CO), Greenlight Gas, Graham County Utilities (Graham County Electric Co-op SmartHub) and about 20 small Texas towns. A pay_bill link was also added to 34 roster rows that already had a website. (2) Upgraded to detailed: Navajo Tribal Utility Authority, Los Alamos County DPU, EMW Gas Association and Deming (partial). These are the remaining municipal, district or tribal systems with 5,000 or more customers in TX, NM, CO, AZ, MT, WY and UT; Graham County Utilities is a co-op and was left as a roster row with links. Jackson), Louisiana (Atmos Louisiana/Trans La divisions), and Kansas (Olathe and other communities). Also TX, CO, VA (out of this file's scope)
entries.mail_payment_address: Atmos Energy, P.O. Box 740353, Cincinnati, OH 45274-0353
entries.payment_processor: in-house Account Center; one-time payment without login (https://www.atmosenergy.com/accountcenter/makepayoutside/makepaymentLanding.html); independent payment centers (https://www.atmosenergy.com/accountcenter/paymentcenter/outsideAC.html)
entries.senior_programs: Sharing the Warmth fuel fund, bill assistance page (LIHEAP referrals), residential payment plan agreements, Budget Billing
entries.notes: Pay Your Bill page covers Account Center, one-time payment, digital wallets, automated phone payments (888-286-6700), payment centers, mail, and the Automatic Payment Plan (sign up in Account Center; bank or credit/debit card; enrolling in auto-pay also enrolls you in E-bill). Cancellation instructions not published publicly — manage in Account Center or call customer service. Customer service M–F; emergencies 866-322-8667. Customer counts are approximate for in-scope states only. Reviewer 2026-09-29: Pay Your Bill page states Account Center lets customers view past statements and usage history (login https://www.atmosenergy.com/accountcenter/logon/login.html); statements_history points to that explanatory page. Residential card/digital-wallet payments (Visa/MC/Discover, PayPal, Venmo, Apple/Google Pay) carry no extra fee online or by phone. THIRD PASS (run 2026-10-01): autopay_cancel = Pay Your Bill page (Automatic Payment Plan section; the Residential Customer Payment Plan Agreement is linked there). Atmos's Automatic Payment Plan Agreement (non-residential PDF fetched this pass) says enrollment can be cancelled any time in the online Account Center (www.atmosenergy.com/accountcenter) or by calling 888-286-6700, and cancellation takes effect the next billing cycle; drafts continue until then.

entries.name: Utility Gas & Power / LE Energy
entries.service_area_detail: LE Energy (EIA-861 2024: ~15,400 Ohio residential electric customers) is the parent of Utility Gas & Power (Ohio/Illinois gas and electric supply: Columbia Gas of Ohio, Dominion East Ohio, Duke, AEP, AES, FirstEnergy) and Michigan Natural Gas LLC
entries.payment_processor: Utility consolidated billing (pay the local utility)
entries.notes: Added by reviewer 2026-09-30 for the EIA row "LE Energy" (15,418 residential). leenergy.com (fetched) says LE Energy is the parent of two retail suppliers and links utilitygasandpower.com and michigannaturalgasllc.com. UGP homepage/FAQ (fetched): one monthly bill from the utility with the UGP rate as a line item; budget billing stays with the utility; contact the utility for billing; utility may charge $10 for more than one switch in 12 months; fixed 12-month plans; there is an online "Pay Early Termination Fee" page (https://www.utilitygasandpower.com/early-termination-payment), so cancelling a fixed plan early can cost an ETF; mailing address 2680 Corporate Park Dr, Ste 100, Opelika, AL 36801. Outside Texas, Georgia and California this supplier normally bills through the local utility (utility consolidated billing): the supply charge is a line on the utility bill, and the senior views, pays, sets up/cancels autopay and sees statement history in the utility's account (PSE&G, PECO, PPL, BGE, Pepco, ComEd, Ameren, AEP Ohio, FirstEnergy, Con Edison, National Grid, etc.). Call the supplier only about the rate, contract, renewal or cancellation. To return to the utility's default service, call the supplier or the utility; the switch takes 1-2 billing cycles. Fixed-rate contracts may carry an early termination fee (ETF) - check the contract summary. Utility-run help (LIHEAP, budget billing, senior/low-income discounts, PIPP/PCAP) still applies; in Ohio PIPP and some NY/PA/MD low-income customers cannot be served by a supplier. | Supersedes roster rows: electric-great-lakes.json: LE Energy
